in_hebrew.name: Stavros
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Stavros הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word stauros, which means 'cross'. In Christian tradition, the name Stavros signifies the sacrifice and suffering of Jesus Christ.

in_latin.name: Stavros
in_latin.long_meaning: Stavros significat crucis signum in lingua Graeca. Origine a verbo Graeco 'stauromai' significans 'crucifigere'. In traditione Christiana, Stavros commemorat passionem et resurrectionem Domini nostri Iesu Christi. Nomen Stavros inductum est ab apparitione Domini post resurrectionem in via Emmaus, ubi discipuli Domini cognoverunt eum in pane et in vino. Stavros est nomen significans fidem et crucem Domini nostri, et est donatum mulieribus, viris, et pueris in traditione Christiana.
